acquisition_method.evidence: Peptides were analyzed using a 90-minute LC gradient and a data-dependent (top 20) acquisition method.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Protein extracts from homogenized tissues were digested with trypsin using S-trap micro spin columns (ProtiFi) according to manufacturer’s instructions.

instrument.evidence: LC-MS/MS analysis was performed using a Dionex Ultimate 3000 nanoLC and an Exploris 480 Orbitrap mass spectrometer.
